sonnet.problem: This true/false card asks about Ezekiel 6:6 before any card has told that verse. The story card that tells it (card 9) comes after, so it repeats the answer the baker has just seen. The baker has to guess with no setup.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
